summary: Independent final review passes for the frozen package under the explicitly documented natural-log and substantive standard probability-concentration interpretation. Closed Lean negations refute required numerical consequences for all real expected-time functions, graph sample maps, and measures; probability wrappers expose normalization and measurability. No random-walk calculation or external class inhabitance is needed.

statement_alignment.accepted_bridge: The full source supplies the universal real ratio lower bound and an actual concentrating graph ensemble. These imply the formally negated necessary conjunction. The implication is one-way, not equivalence. Additional upper bound, endpoint and branching clauses are dropped only for refutation.
statement_alignment.bilingual_difference: Chinese introductory h_max prose differs from the English; both display the same expected blanket/cover ratio and both contain the numeric clauses used. The proof does not select a favorable time convention.
statement_alignment.varying_sizes: Documented common discrete space of eligible finite labelled graphs, with size-supported probability laws and identity sampling. This is a representation bridge, not a calculated/fabricated graph law.

mathematics: For each natural-log parse a<=1; if X>=4/3, then X-a>=1/3. The epsilon=1/6 open neighborhood is empty, its actual measure is zero, and the constant-zero sequence cannot converge to one under the nontrivial Nat.atTop filter. No approximation is used by the proof.

lean_bridge.probability_definition: Each law explicitly satisfies IsProbabilityMeasure and each real random variable is Measurable; projection to the broader necessary neighborhood-mass condition is proved. Closed source-facing targets leave no additional lower-bound/existence/admissibility assumption outside the negated conjunction.

reproduction.auxiliary_numeric_checks: 10 finite regression checks only; not graph data or the infinite proof

page_notes: Page 1: title, attribution, both numerical clauses, ratios and logarithm lemma readable; no clipping or overlap.
Page 2: impossibility proof, Mathlib pin, theorem/definition map and concentration interpretation readable; no clipping or overlap.
Page 3: trust/scope limits, source provenance and references readable; no clipping or overlap.

assumptions_interpretation: Natural logarithms, covering both (log 3)/2 and log(3/2).
Concentration is substantive existence of an actual asymptotic graph ensemble/probability law sequence; not a vacuous universal assertion over an unspecified empty TreeLike class.
The ratio is real-valued on eligible sampled graphs where the stated expectation ratio is defined.
The universal graph lower bound transfers pointwise to every valid sample.
Independent AI-context review, not independent human expert or organizer review.
limitations: Does not compute either expected time, construct a random walk, identify a corrected spectrum, or decide which individual source clause is false.
Operational blanket-time definitions, endpoint attainability and branching models are not formalized because the contradiction is uniform over all real interpretations.
No base-2 or deterministic Tendsto corollary is advertised as kernel-proved by this package.

Used exact existing dependency checkouts and generated caches via ignored junctions. The submission project was clean-rebuilt; fresh online dependency bootstrap, cross-platform reproduction and rebuilding all dependency caches from scratch were not tested.
The actual frozen PDF was independently rendered and all pages visually reviewed; optional independent Tectonic regeneration was not performed.
Fresh upstream duplicate/publication/policy/claim checks are outside this review and remain the coordinator responsibility.
